description: D6.3 COVERAGE (F-D). The ONLY fixture that requires a block. The feature flag is disabled, so the pipeline refuses at stage 2 with policy_blocked and reason 'feature_flag_disabled' — before any gate and before any model call, so this is deterministic and costs nothing. The input is deliberately the strong_fit input: a fixture that blocked because of BAD input would prove nothing, since it could block for the wrong reason. This blocks for exactly one reason. A 'succeeded' here means the runtime executed an agent whose flag was OFF — the dangerous asymmetry D6.3 exists to catch — so status is critical_if_failed. gate_outcomes is absent because no gate runs; the schema enforces that absence rather than allowing it.
